result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner's white headline and subtext sit on a very light mint background, leaving the promo code nearly unreadable. The rest of the page (header, search, category chips, carousels, popular list, bottom navigation) renders correctly. Clipped carousel and chip items and the card cut off at the bottom were excluded as intended behavior.

issues.description: In the promo banner, the headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white text on a very light mint-green background. The contrast is far below WCAG minimums, so the promo code and its conditions are nearly invisible. Only the 'Order now' button is clearly legible, so users see a call to action without the offer details it depends on.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., the app's dark green or near-black) on the light background, or switch the banner to a saturated dark green background that keeps the white text. Aim for at least 4.5:1 contrast for the subtext and 3:1 for the large headline. Check the theme or token mapping in case the text color was meant for a darker banner variant.
